specification: KTP-FEDERATION Section 10.2 (Policy Coordination) and KTP-GOVERNANCE Section 11.3 (Amendment Constraints)
note: Normative downstream requirements for recognition without codification: a recognized local rule creates no term, and no amendment removes a class's standing to object. This repository contains no runtime: these vectors fix the decisions a conformant deployment produces at the boundaries the two documents name and define no formula. given/expect are test notation, not wire fields; an agreement or charter shown in `given` is the signed instrument for the case, and a clause is shown by its effect.

vectors.reason: Recognition of a zone's local rule creates no term and no obligation on any zone and MUST NOT be made a condition of membership; the clause is void and the agreement stands.
A coordination a federation offers is adopted by a zone's own act and MAY be withdrawn by the same; neither act is a term of the agreement.

amendment.effect: lineages below Analyst tier may no longer open an amendment or object in the ratification window

vectors.reason: An amendment MUST NOT remove, from any class of participants, the standing to open an amendment, to contest a refusal, or to object; one that does is void and the charter otherwise stands, whatever its approval share.
